Maria: Heads up — vendor sync with NVIDIA + Habana tomorrow 10:00am PT to triage SI onramp for Gaudi + MI300. Need to lock marketplace listing windows, embargo cadence, and firmware/cert tags. Can folks confirm availability? @Jun @Dan
Jun: I'll be on. Can we get a legal pre-review? @Priya timezone check (PT/CEST)
Priya: I can take legal review. Need embargo copy + asset list. What's marketing timeline? @Alex
Alex: Marketing prefers ~72h embargo lead. Proposed press embargo Wed 09:00 PT. Need banners + 1-pager + FAQ.
Dan: Infra note — MI300 kernel 2.21 patch expected next week; we should gate announcement on cert image validation. If kernel regressions surface, recommend fallback to delayed internal comms only.
Maria: Agreed. Gate on kernel validation + SI E2E on marketplace image. If certs slip, no public announce. Ops perform dry-run.
Jun: Checklist draft:
```
- Firmware tags: h100-v3 / mi300-v2 / gaudi-r4
- Cert image: redwood-marketplace-v1.2
- E2E SI test: perf/latency/regression
- Embargo: start 2026-04-15 09:00 PT
- Legal signoff: PRIYA
- Marketing assets: banner, FAQ, release notes
- SI contacts: list in calendar invite
```
Priya: I'll prepare embargo wording and legal signoff template.
Maria: Sample embargo blurb: `Embargo until 2026-04-15 09:00 PT. Press may not publish before this date/time.`
Alex: Ops — can you run marketplace dry-run tomorrow? @Dan please coordinate with SI integrators. Also need partner contact list for press routing.
Dan: Ops can run dry-run at 12:00 PT tomorrow. Adding deploy-bot to schedule.
deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: job 78412, results expected by 12:30 PT — artifacts posted to #eng-runtime.
Maria: Thanks — I'll send calendar invite now. Agenda: cert gating, fallback plan, embargo wording, launch timeline, SI checklist. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/gaudi-mi300-onramp
Priya: :thumbsup:
